verdict.rationale: Decagon's docs describe real-time, scoped access to customer systems via short-lived JWT tokens and MCP-based integrations, plus identity-provider integrations and Browser Actions to reach any system a support agent could — implying live data (plan, order status, account history) can inform answers. However, there is no concrete example or case study showing a specific customer query answered with live order/account data, and technical documentation is gated (docs.decagon.ai requires login), limiting independent verification. Missing for 10: a concrete example/case study of live-data-grounded answers (e.g., order status lookup in a real transcript) and independent/third-party corroboration beyond vendor marketing pages.
